messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water at Walmart near San Jose. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with location "San Jose" or "near San Jose" and product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"] and pack_size [12] maybe? Actually pack_size array should match product_list length. For apples and rice, no pack size needed. For bottled water, pack_size 12. So pack_size array should be [null, null, 12] or maybe [0,0,12]? The function signature says pack_size?: number[], default not use if not specified. So we can provide pack_size: [12] but that mismatches length. But maybe we can provide pack_size: [12] and the function will interpret that as pack size for bottled water only. But the spec says "Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list." So we need to provide array of same length. So we can provide pack_size: [0,0,12] or [null,null,12]. But the type is number[]. So we can provide [0,0,12] or [1,1,12] but 0 indicates not used. Let's do [0,0,12].

Thus call function.
